items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1 always-on drift test pins each profile fragment to the template block; AC2 real ESLint 10 run recorded in eslint-seeded-run.txt; AC3 the real-ESLint pytest skips without Node but is not the evidence.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Config load errors and parse errors fail the real-ESLint test (fatal messages, exit 2); under CI a missing Node fails instead of skipping; the skill step never skips silently when a legacy config exists.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Skill step uses file tools only, no shell command and no placeholder in double quotes (doc test); template is static.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Parser/fragments-last ordering, unchanged fragment equality, no two fragments setting the same rule, real ESLint flags every seeded case with its rule and flags no compliant or exempt file; the emulation was replaced.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Real-ESLint test installs into a temp dir once per module (about 5 s).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Tests split into two files under 300 lines; marker comments name the rule id.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer profile JSON fragments to JS template to consumer ESLint: real round trip run; case files placed in numbered folders because a renamed opengraph-image file had escaped its ignore glob (found and fixed in the harness).

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No sleeps; temp dir per module; no shared state.
